text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create paintings, compose music, and even write stories or poems. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. Can a machine truly be creative? AI can copy styles and mix ideas in clever ways, but it does not have feelings or personal experiences. Human creativity comes from emotions, memories, and imagination. Perhaps the best result is when people and AI work together, using technology as a tool to help express new ideas.
